title: Gravitational scattering amplitudes in collinear and high-energy limits
summary: In this thesis we study the high-energy and collinear behaviour of gravitational scattering amplitudes and their relation to classical scattering and radiation observables. Multi-Regge kinematics, characterised by a strong rapidity ordering, provides the factorised building blocks governing the leading logarithmic structure. Relaxing this ordering to next-to-multi-Regge kinematics allows two neighbouring particles to have comparable rapidities and provides the real emission building blocks entering at next-to-leading logarithmic accuracy.
